summary: Iter181 — Tested PBX recording/queues/skill routing + Lost-6 frontend sweep. All 10 iter180 backend tests pass; added cascade-on-delete spot check (queue delete -> inbound destination_type='hangup', verified). Frontend new features (Queues tab, Recording tab, Extension dialog recording/skills, Inbound dest=queue) all render and persist via UI.
